speech: This is my card after one week, and this is it after 12.
You can't see it, but your mattress
could be hiding a colony of dust mites deep in the foam
where washing sprays and vacuums never reach.
The plant-derived lure draws them up and out.
The adhesive locks them on the card,
and your foam light shows you everything.
Every other thing I tried asked me to believe it was working,
even when I felt it wasn't.
If you have dust mites or you wake up blocked and tired,
you already know you need this.
Black Friday, up to 12 free cards, save up to 79%.
